_comment: Dataset-campaign copy of 03_n2f_testing (isotropic n=1.5 reservoir, dye gain ON) with source_1.dlam set to 0.1 so it MATCHES 04_adding_LC exactly; 03-vs-04 then isolates the LC birefringence and nothing else. Created 2026-07-28 for the overnight nonlinearity/capacity campaign; the original 03_n2f_testing is left untouched (it carries an unrelated in-progress dlam edit).

reservoir._comment: Isotropic dye-doped medium: uniform n=1.5, no LC constants, no relaxation, no lc_fields.npz; gain via the sted block, now genuinely PUMP-DRIVEN (see sted.N1_0/N3_0 below) via source_pump instead of pre-inverted.

sted._comment: 4-level dye starting PRE-INVERTED: initial_populations = [N1_0, 0, N3_0, 0] = [0, 0, 30, 0], so the whole population already sits in upper lasing level 3 at t=0 and the signal at lbdE=0.55 sees gain immediately. source_pump (Ez, absorption line lbdA=0.45) therefore does not build the inversion, it sustains and tops up one that exists from t=0. Comment corrected 2026-07-30: it previously described a ground-state start (N1_0=30, N3_0=0) that these values never had -- 02_adding_pump is the design that genuinely does that, and 05_cav_unpumped is the deliberate ground-state control.

source_1._comment: Plain (non-beam) Gaussian-envelope PULSE at 500nm injected at the LEFT edge of guide_1 -- switched 2026-07-24 from a focused gaussianbeam(exact2d=true) because that beam type's amplitude is a NO-OP by design (confirmed against real MEEP's own GaussianBeam2DSource.get_fields: it normalizes by dividing by a norm computed from the SAME amplitude-scaled field, canceling |E0| entirely -- only phase/direction survive), which silently broke the amplitude sweep. This plain source_type genuinely scales with amplitude. start_time=100.0 delays the pulse so it arrives AFTER the continuous pump (source_pump) has already built up substantial population inversion, to probe the actual gain rather than launching signal and pump simultaneously from a cold, uninverted medium. amplitude switched to a 4-element list 2026-07-26 (per user request, for a richer IPC/capacity polynomial target basis than 2 channels gives) -- return_quadrosource/_strip_sources splits the size.y=10.0 extent into n_strips=4 equal 2.5-unit-tall independent-amplitude point sources. 2-strip results are preserved under datasets/2strip_backup/.

source_pump._comment: Uniform 2D-area CW pump filling the reservoir's own footprint (not a guided line source like source_1) at the dye's absorption line lbdA=0.45 -- Ez polarization, orthogonal to source_1's guided Ey signal at the emission line lbdE=0.55, so pump and probe don't directly interfere in the FDTD fields. Drives real N1->N3 population transfer from a genuine ground-state start (sted.N1_0=30/N3_0=0). amplitude=200 (2026-07-24, per user request) -- between amp=100 (gradual buildup, ~35-57% inversion over 100-200 units) and amp=1000 (near-instant ~98% saturation by t~20), so this should show an intermediate, still-visible buildup curve.

pop_monitor._comment: Atom-level sensor: saves N(t) for all 4 dye levels over the reservoir; snap_interval in MEEP time units (1 unit = 3.336 fs)

n2f_map._comment_lam: 61-frequency comb 0.4-0.6, matching monitor_1/monitor_2 so all three sensors share one wavelength axis (SimpleSim de2b284: near2far takes lam_range+n_lam like the 1Ddft monitors, EH gains a leading frequency axis).
n2f_map._comment_npoints: Single 1x200 column at x=199.5 um spanning y in [-100, 100]: the generators read EH[-1,:], so one column is all that is used, and the far-field transform cost scales with n_points x n_lam — 1x200 x 61 freqs is affordable where 200x200 x 61 would be hours per sample (the single-frequency 200x200 map was already ~40 min, 2026-07-30). NOTE this is NOT byte-identical to the old 200x200/size-200 map: that one read its last column at x=300; this reads at x=199.5, and the full 200 um y span is kept so the captured angular range is unchanged.

line_snap._comment: Time-domain LINE record at monitor_2's location, all 3 components ({t, Ex, Ey, Ez}, dt=0.1 ~ 5 samples/optical period). Added 2026-08-07 to resolve the cavity's circulating pulse per drive level; picked up into part files as ls_* by data_gen/_gen_common._load_extras.
